studio.name: Stafbyte
studio.about: Stafbyte is an independent game studio from Australia. We make colourful, easy-to-pick-up games for your phone: pixel-art puzzles, cartoon tycoons and whatever we think of next.

games.name: Pixel Sudoku
games.blurb: Fill the grid, add up the cages, collect cards and postcards. Daily puzzles, events and four difficulties.
games.description: Pixel Sudoku is a cosy pixel-art take on Killer Sudoku. Fill the grid so every row, column and 3x3 box holds 1 to 9, and every dashed cage adds up to the small number in its corner. No digit repeats inside a cage.
features: Four difficulties
Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert puzzles, all with a single solution.
Daily Challenge
A new puzzle every day, with a calendar and gold stars.
Events
Sudoku Adventure, First Try Challenge, Creative Studio, Forest World and Cage Rush.
Collect cards
Win a game to get a card. Six themes and five rarities, from Common to Legendary.
Postcards and stamps
Finish Forest World levels to reveal postcards and collect stamps.
Made for phones
Notes, undo, hints, light and dark mode. Works offline.
games.note: Free to play with ads. Remove them any time with a one-time purchase.

games.name: Street Kings: Idle Tycoon
games.tagline: From the corner to the crown
games.blurb: A cartoon idle tycoon. Build your block, hire your crew and keep the cash rolling in, even while you are away.
games.description: Build your block, run your operations, hire a crew of characters and watch the cash roll in, even while you are away. A cartoon idle tycoon with a story, events and a street that never stops growing.
games.note: Free to play. Optional ads and purchases. No account needed.
features: Build and automate
Open new operations, upgrade them, hire managers and automate the whole block so it keeps earning while you are offline.
Collect your crew
Dozens of characters to find, level up and dress. Card packs and crates reward the way you play.
Chapters without end
A story across many chapters, then endless ones that keep getting tougher. Every chapter is a fresh climb from the bottom.
Events all year
Rotating and seasonal events open a separate park with its own levels, start cash and leaderboard tiers.
Fair and optional
Every ad is your choice and the game is fully playable without paying. Time skips credit your earnings as if the hours had passed.
Play your way
Short check-ins or long sessions. Your progress is saved on your device and there is nothing to sign up for.
